pr_summary: The `--isolated` global flag is currently hidden from help output (`hide = true`). The fix makes this flag visible in all help displays (`uv --help`, `uv help`, and subcommand help). The flag prevents discovery of `pyproject.toml` or `uv.toml` configuration files.
candidate_test_commands: cargo nextest run --features python-patch --workspace --status-level skip --failure-output immediate-final --no-fail-fast -j 12 --final-status-level slow

fix_patch.change: Removed `hide = true` from the `#[arg(global = true, long)]` attribute for the `isolated` field in GlobalArgs struct
fix_patch.line_context: Line ~151: Changed from `#[arg(global = true, long, hide = true)]` to `#[arg(global = true, long)]`

test_patch.changes: Adds `--isolated` flag with description to multiple test snapshots (help, help_flag, help_short_flag, help_subcommand, help_subsubcommand, help_flag_subcommand, help_flag_subsubcommand, help_with_global_option)
expected_output_lines: Avoid discovering a `pyproject.toml` or `uv.toml` file in the current directory or any parent directories

platform_constraint_evidence: CI workflow ci.yml runs cargo test on ubuntu-latest-large, macos-14, and windows-latest-large
README.md states: 'Support for macOS, Linux, and Windows'
Cargo.toml targets include x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, x86_64-apple-darwin and more
CONTRIBUTING.md provides setup instructions for Linux, macOS, and Windows
No Windows-only or macOS-only restrictions in fix.patch touched files
notes: This is the 'uv' project - a Rust-based Python package installer. The fix is a simple one-line change to make the --isolated flag visible in help output. Tests use insta snapshot testing. The project uses cargo-nextest for running tests. Python toolchains are installed via 'cargo run python install'. The test file help.rs contains snapshot tests that verify the exact help output format.
